comment: Bifrost Server Configuration. 'network.port' sets the default TCP port (UDP discovery uses a fixed port, 7891, auto-detected by the Amiga - no need to match it manually); 'python main.py --port N' overrides it for one-off runs. Mouse tuning (hz/hz_drag/speed/delta_max/curve) is owned by the Amiga daemon and received automatically over the wire - see Bifrost's CLI HZ=/HZDRAG=/SPEED=/DELTAMAX=/CURVELINEAR=/CURVERATIO= arguments.
